name: MALDI-MS single scan (DHB matrix, imzML export)
instrument: MALDI imaging, 150 um raster, positive mode
notes: Single MS1 centroid spectrum (scan=18081) exported from an imzML imaging run. 2,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid (DHB) matrix in positive mode: dehydrated matrix ion [M+H-H2O]+ at m/z 137.023 (base region) and protonated matrix [M+H]+ at m/z 155.034 (-2.0 ppm) confirm the matrix; the dominant high-mass peaks (m/z 311.0, 366.96, 350.99) carry the analyte/matrix-cluster information used by the identification demo.
